mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, price, stock, image, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, image = #{image}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
